title: Meet me in the mountains
description: Crisp air, winding roads, and mountain mornings. Build a Himalayan escape around the season and your sense of adventure.

itinerary.title: Into the mountains
itinerary.text: Arrive in Manali and take time to rest after your journey.

itinerary.title: Wander a little
itinerary.text: Explore village lanes and local cafés at an easy pace.

itinerary.title: Valley views
itinerary.text: Plan a scenic valley excursion based on weather and road conditions.

itinerary.title: Your kind of adventure
itinerary.text: Choose from locally available activities; costs and suitability are confirmed separately.

itinerary.title: Leave room for the unexpected
itinerary.text: Keep a flexible day for another excursion or a relaxed mountain morning.

itinerary.title: Carry the mountains home
itinerary.text: Check out and begin your onward journey.
